items.title: Breath of a Whale Captured by Drone Allows Full Genome Sequencing Without Intrusion
items.summary: The exhale from a whale’s blowhole has been captured by drones, and used to complete the genome sequencing of one of the ocean giants for the first time. Researchers from the University of St. Andrews…
